reuse.why: Places the guard in the existing linkBankSyncAccount funnel that all five provider handlers call, using the existing db.all helper.

duplication.why: One check covers every provider; nothing is repeated.

placement.why: The rule sits at the top of the shared link function in accounts/app.ts, before the bank lookup, any write or the sync.

scope.why: Only the guard and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: A short, readable check in the single place linking happens, so new providers inherit it automatically.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all *-accounts-link handlers
